description.value: Meet Fresh is a Taiwanese dessert chain founded in 2007, serving traditional handmade desserts including taro balls, grass jelly, tofu pudding, shaved ice, and herbal teas made without preservatives from natural ingredients. The Richmond location is part of the Canadian franchise network bringing authentic Central Taiwanese flavours to the Lower Mainland. A good stop for a sweet treat mid-ride, with a largely vegetarian-friendly menu.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 12m; rack at 43m; rack at 71m.
